entities.title: Examples for constraint and calendar-rule
entities.summary: They are the only core kinds without an example in valid.json.
entities.details: valid.json covers 24 of the 26 core kinds. Resolving it additively is a minor version (1.1); renaming or removing fields is a major version; clarifying prose without changing any serialized form or result is a patch (VERSIONING.md).
acceptanceCriteria: valid.json has at least one structurally valid value of kind constraint and one of kind calendar-rule, and tools/validate.py passes.
